episodes.title: The History of AI Explained
episodes.description: Trace AI’s development and explore how benchmarks and scaling laws inform expectations about its future capabilities.

episodes.title: How could AI transform society?
episodes.description: Explore possible social and economic consequences of more capable AI, including both hopeful and harmful futures.

episodes.title: How close are we to the worst case scenario?
episodes.description: In this episode, we’ll explore how humans (and computers) make progress, and try to find out just how powerful AI could become.

episodes.title: The Alignment Problem Explained
episodes.description: In this episode, we explore how powerful AI could end up causing us harm, regardless of what it’s programmed for.

episodes.title: How Should AI Be Governed?
episodes.description: Explore approaches to governing AI, from laboratory policies to international agreements, and the challenges of coordinating responsible development.
